title: PDF viewer: pages, search, selection and touch

clauses.text: On a touch screen, a two-finger pinch zooms the page and a two-finger swipe turns pages.

steps.do: On a machine with a touch screen, open a multi-page PDF. Pinch two fingers apart, then together. Then slide two fingers sideways across the page.
steps.expect: The pinch zooms in and out and the sideways swipe turns to the next or previous page. A one-finger scroll still scrolls the page.
